messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of the 2026-06-18 rotation, Diego holds the Ember team pager. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
    earlier: As of the 2026-05-18 rotation, Oskar holds the Ember team pager, having taken it over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
    earlier: As of the 2026-03-31 rotation, Diego Alvarez holds the Ember team pager, having taken it over from Oskar. [valid 2026-03-31 to 2026-05-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On 2026-06-18, the Ember team on-call swapped and Diego carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
- Oskar runs the weekly architecture review. [valid 2026-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-16]
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- On 2026-05-18, Oskar picked up the Ember team on-call shift from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- For anything Ember-related, page Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
    earlier: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to 2026-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-3]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, and flagged it since the feature-flags service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team observed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- The ledger has no deploys from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service lives with Team Cinder; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Boreal as of 2025-09-29. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-09-29; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2026-02-24, the flags service belongs to Team Cinder; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-29, the flags service belongs to Team Boreal; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-09, the flags service belongs to Team Cinder; Team Atlas ran it until then. [valid 2025-07-09 to 2025-09-29; recorded by handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags]
- On the 2026-02-12 rotation day, the Ember team on-call swapped and Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
    earlier: As of the 2025-12-29 rotation day, Diego is on call for the Ember team, having received the pager from Oskar. [valid 2025-12-29 to 2026-02-12; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline lives with Team Cinder; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
